customMethods.name: save
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("save() called")
	scheduleBlockInfo = dict(self.view.custom.values)
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	
	try:	#shift dropdown allows custom options. If it is not an int, then user has just created this shift
		int(scheduleBlockInfo['shiftNameId'])
	except:
		scheduleBlockInfo['shiftNameId'] = system.kanoa.shift.addShiftName(scheduleBlockInfo['shiftNameId'], userId)	
	shiftId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('shiftId', system.kanoa.shift.getShifts({'assetId':scheduleBlockInfo['assetId'], 'shiftNameId': scheduleBlockInfo['shiftNameId']}))
	if shiftId is None: shiftId = system.kanoa.shift.addShift({'assetId':scheduleBlockInfo['assetId'], 'shiftNameId': scheduleBlockInfo['shiftNameId'], 'shiftColor': scheduleBlockInfo['shiftColor']}, userId)
	else: system.kanoa.shift.updateShiftField(shiftId, 'shiftColor', scheduleBlockInfo['shiftColor'], userId)
	scheduleBlockInfo['shiftId'] = shiftId
	
	recurrenceChangeType = self.view.custom.recurrence.changeType
	eventInfo = {'scheduleBlockInfo': scheduleBlockInfo, 'changeType': recurrenceChangeType, 'start': self.view.custom.dates.start, 'end': self.view.custom.dates.end}
		
	if scheduleBlockInfo['shiftBlockId'] is None: system.perspective.sendMessage("createEvent", eventInfo) #add event
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage("adjustEvent", eventInfo) #Update existing event
	
	system.perspective.closePopup('')
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteExceptions
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print('deleteExceptions()called')
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	
	for exception in self.view.custom.exceptions.selection.data:
		system.kanoa.shift.deleteShiftBlockException(exception['shiftBlockExceptionId'], userId)
		
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.exceptions.data")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("exceptionsUpdated")
		
	return

system.perspective.print('updateRecurringOption() msg rcvd with %s'%payload)
	self.view.custom.recurrence.state = 'update' if (payload['uuid'] or None) is not None else 'new'
	if (self.view.custom.values.rruleStr or None) is None and (payload['rruleStr'] or None) is not None: 
		self.view.custom.recurrence.changeType = 'All events'	#prevents recurrencePopup from being displayed when we are changing a non recurring event to a recurring event
		
	self.view.custom.values.rruleStr = payload['rruleStr']
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.display.currentTab")
	
	return
